title: mediaplane.apply/v1

ok.description: the apply succeeded, or there was nothing to change; apply exits 0 then

changed.description: apply changed something on the host or in the apps

outcome.description: invalid: the plan failed, and nothing was changed; cancelled: nothing was changed

path.description: relative to the Mediaplane home, such as `generated/compose.yaml`

diff.description: a unified diff from the file on disk; empty when the file is unchanged, or holds secrets

sensitive.description: it holds secrets: compared with the file on disk, never shown

prestart.description: written once, before the app's first start, and never updated

service.description: the Compose service, such as sonarr

containers.description: what Compose does to each service

generate.description: the secrets apply generates, by name, such as `sonarr.apiKey`

recover.description: the keys apply recovers from the apps' appdata, which `state/secrets.json` lacks

restore.description: the keys apply puts back in their apps' own files, stopping each app first

unhealthy.description: running apps whose health check has not passed yet, such as `sonarr (unhealthy)`: apply waits for them

resource.description: `<app>.<resource>`, or `<app>` alone for an app Mediaplane only checks

action.description: adopt: the app holds it as wanted, and Mediaplane records it; after-start: checked once its app runs; unknown: Mediaplane could not ask the app (`reason` says why); remove: Mediaplane made it, and the stack no longer wants it

changes.description: the managed fields and secrets that differ, by name

reason.description: why it could not be checked

wiring.description: what apply does to each managed resource

app.description: the app whose first-run setup apply finishes, such as jellyfin

unpublished.description: it starts with no published port until its setup is done

again.description: present, and true, only when the setup signs in again with what you rotated (`--rotate plex.token`), published or not

resource.description: the wire step names the resource, such as `sonarr.admin`

detail.description: what it did, for people: a wire action says `created`, `updated`, `adopted`, `unchanged` or `removed`, and a skipped one why, such as why a planned removal stays; the first-run setup step says what it set up and published, and `signed in again to <app>`

recordId.description: the change record written (`mediaplane history <id>`), or null

severity.description: an error stopped the command; a warning did not

code.description: what it is, such as `config.unknown-key`: stable, for scripts to act on; the message is for people and may change

diagnostics.description: every error and warning, in the order found
